findings.claim: A sheet can contain more than one drawing scale, and reproduction can alter the printed scale; verify against a known value before measurement.

support.section: Using the tool and interpreting the results

findings.applicability: Corroborates the existing source-bound verified-scale requirement; not a new duct measurement convention.
findings.chronology: Source verification occurred after implementation began; this research did not originate those tests.

findings.claim: The FEMA fire-inspection scale-training example gives written dimensions precedence over scaled measurements.
findings.conflict: Approved D05 keeps dimension-versus-scale conflicts unresolved instead of silently selecting one basis. This source teaches a fire-inspection context and does not replace the approved product rule.
findings.resolution: Preserve D05 and flag the difference. No automatic precedence or tolerance introduced.

findings.claim: The four selected N11 references are catalog/product descriptions or UFGS metadata/revision-history pages, not the full mechanical measurement texts named by their titles. They do not substantiate centerline takeoff, separate fitting-count, vertical/sloped measurement or duplicate-depiction rules.

support.section: Description, Details, Table of Contents; full indexed text reviewed as catalog outline

findings.resolution: Keep the approved owner packet as current rule authority. Obtain and verify applicable full text before admitting public references as mechanical rule support.
findings.not_generalized_to: Other source content in these notebooks was not exhausted; no claim that the notebooks contain no usable rule sources.

findings.claim: The indexed ASHRAE Duct Fitting Database description concerns fitting loss coefficients and pressure-loss calculations. It does not supply a duct takeoff centerline-length rule.

support.section: Duct Fitting Database and associated Standard 120 resources

findings.applicability: Supports keeping pressure-loss engineering data distinct from physical measured quantities and separate fitting counts; no calculation coefficients imported.

findings.claim: N10 and N11 contain repeated source titles; there are 34 duplicate-title groups in N10 and 29 in N11. Title equality does not prove equal source bytes or independent evidence.
findings.resolution: Query one explicit source ID per selected title, retain all IDs in the index, and compare text/source bytes before deduplication.
